''See also: [[Akura Malice Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Akura clan|Akura]] [[Malice]] is the [[Monarch]] and ruler of the [[Akura clan]], a powerful family known for their mastery of [[shadow madra]]. Known as [[the Queen]] of Shadows, she governs the western [[Ashwind continent]] from her territory, which features a capital city called [[Moongrave]]. Her presence is often characterized by an aesthetic of intimidating purple and black, including floating fortresses and a [[throne]] made of shadows. [[Malice]] is a practitioner of the Eternal Night [[Path]], which she developed as an idealized version of her pure [[shadow Path]]; while she does not use a Book herself, she is famous for creating the [[Path of Seven Pages]] used by her descendants. Her combat abilities are immense, involving Shadow{{!}}shadow-based techniques, archery, and a bloodline legacy of armor. She is described as a figure of immense power who can manipulate the future and command vast shadows, possessing a personality that reflects her name through her mercilessness toward enemies. As a leader, [[Malice]] maintains a strict and demanding standard for her lineage. Her children must undergo rigorous trials within dream-worlds to prove their talent; those who fail are relegated to branch families and are denied contact with her. Despite this severity, she has shown personal investment in certain descendants, such as her daughter [[Akura Mercy]]. The [[Akura clan]] under her leadership is noted for its immense reach, resources, and a reputation for being neither honorable nor merciful in their dealings with those who oppose them.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[the Queen|The Queen]] of Shadows is clad in [[amethyst armor]] and a violet dress adorned with silver [[chains]] and amethysts in her hair. Her eyes blaze with pure, endless purple light, and she possesses purple nails that may be crystallized. She has been seen lounging on a [[Forged]] [[throne]] of shadows or standing in midair above her mountain.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Akura clan|Akura]] [[Malice]] is a ruler who would rather die than leave the world and refuses to let those who stand in a [[Monarch]]'s way live. She maintains high expectations for [[Lindon]] and possesses a will that fights for control of [[Mercy]]'s [[spirit]].}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|She is the mother of [[Mercy]], [[Akura Pride|Pride]], and [[Akura Fury]]. She has given her blessing to [[Eithan]], is the chosen of [[Wei Shi Lindon Arelius]], and has expectations for [[Lindon]]. Additionally, [[Eithan|Eithan Arelius]] fights for her, [[Min Shuei]] appealed to her, and she is a target for [[Sopharanatoth]]'s [[Penance]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Following the [[Path]] of Eternal Night, she is the creator of the [[Path of Seven Pages]] and practices a pure [[shadow Path]] emphasizing [[Forger]] and [[Ruler techniques]]. Her powers include the [[World of Night]] [[technique]], using [[Shadow|shadow]] tendrils to seize targets, and utilizing a [[Monarch]]-level [[messenger construct]]. She also wields a shimmering blue bow with a shaft of glacial ice.}}
